entities.name: Jason Carthalion
entities.description: Mighty hero of Dominaria's Ice Age, ward of Oriel Kjeldos and champion of Clan Emerald.

entities.name: Oriel Kjeldos
entities.description: Champion and leader of Clan Emerald of Storgard, a green mana user who took Jason in as her ward.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Planeswalker of Clan Ruby who tutored Jason in ice magic and dueled him.

entities.name: Clan Emerald
entities.description: Clan of Storgard led by Oriel Kjeldos.

entities.name: King Miko
entities.description: King who called Jason to duel Freyalise.

entities.name: Fyndhorn Bow
entities.description: Weapon Jason used to triumph over Freyalise.

entities.name: Shield of the Ages
entities.description: Shield Jason used in the duel.

entities.name: Seklistis
entities.description: Jason's bonded woolly spider, killed by Kianon.

entities.name: Kianon
entities.description: Freyalise's grizzled wolverine that killed Seklistis.

entities.name: Storgard
entities.description: Place of the duel; abandoned before the Fall of Storgard.

entities.name: Mariska
entities.description: Recovered forbidden weapons with Oriel and gave them to Jason.

events.summary: Jason is orphaned when his parents are lost to the cold, and Oriel Kjeldos takes him in as her ward.
events.quote: Oriel Kjeldos , leader of Clan Emerald , took him in as her ward.

events.summary: King Miko, manipulated by Tevesh Szat, calls Jason to duel Freyalise as Clan Emerald's champion.
events.quote: King Miko called upon him to duel Freyalise as champion of Clan Emerald .

events.summary: Jason triumphs over Freyalise with the Fyndhorn Bow and Shield of the Ages, fatally wounding her; she ascends and converts to green.
events.quote: He fatally wounded Freyalise, who ascended .

events.summary: Kianon kills Seklistis in the duel at Storgard.
events.quote: It was killed by Freyalise 's grizzled wolverine Kianon

events.summary: Jason leaves Storgard with Oriel Kjeldos and the clan before the Fall of Storgard.
events.quote: Later, Jason left Storgard with Oriel Kjeldos and the others of his clan
